phrases.phrase: Click this button to register your site with ForumCopilot API and obtain a site ID. Use this if registration failed during installation.
Your site is not registered yet. Please register your site first.
Direct push (your own white-label app + Firebase)

Text shown next to a member's name in "Members Online" and "Currently viewing this thread" lists when their session was last touched by the mobile app API. Default is "Using Forum Copilot Mobile App". Customise for your brand (e.g. "On the QHHT app"). Leave empty to disable the label entirely (the user will still appear online but with no activity description).

If set, the activity label above becomes a clickable link to this URL — useful for pointing readers at your app's App Store / Play Store listing or a marketing page. Default points at https://forumcopilot.com/getapps, a device-aware redirect that takes the visitor to the Apple App Store on iOS, the Google Play Store on Android, or the Forum Copilot homepage on desktop. Clear this field to render the label as plain text instead of a link.
Used by Hosted push above. API key for authenticating with the Forum Copilot push notification service. Automatically set during site registration; you usually don't need to change this.
Used by Hosted push above. The URL of your Forum Copilot push notification backend service. Default points to the official forumcopilot.com hosted backend.

Absolute filesystem path on this server to the Firebase service-account JSON file for your Firebase project. Generate this file in the Firebase Console under Project Settings → Service accounts → "Generate new private key", then upload it to this server (outside your web root for security) and paste the full path here. Required for "Direct push" to actually dispatch.

Dispatch push notifications directly to Firebase Cloud Messaging using your own Firebase project credentials (set the path below). Use this if you ship a white-label mobile app built from the Forum Copilot Open Source codebase. When enabled but the credentials path is empty, this option is silently ignored — no errors, no log spam. Both this and "Hosted push" can be enabled simultaneously: each device is routed through whichever path it registered with.

Master kill switch for ALL push notifications. When off, no pushes are dispatched regardless of the Hosted/Direct settings below. Turn off to temporarily disable push delivery without losing your configuration.

Dispatch push notifications through the hosted Forum Copilot push backend (configured by the Push API URL above). Required if any of your users install the official Forum Copilot mobile app from the App Store / Play Store. Safe to leave on; pushes only fire for devices registered against this backend.
Edit your forum information (name, description, logo, language, country) that appears in ForumCopilot.

Google Play package name for the Android app the banner should link to (e.g. com.forumcopilot.mobile). Leave the default to point at the Forum Copilot app, or replace it with your own package name if you ship a branded version.

Shows a small "Open in app" banner to visitors on iOS and Android mobile browsers. The banner is dismissible, automatically yields to other sticky bottom elements (cookie bars, anchor ads), and never overlaps your site features. We appreciate you keeping this setting ON to help make this project sustainable — mobile app sales are the only way we fund this project.
Optional. URL of the icon shown on the left side of the banner. Leave blank to use the default Forum Copilot icon. Recommended size: 88×88 or 128×128 PNG.

Numeric App Store ID for the iOS app the banner should link to (e.g. 6755660616). Leave the default to point at the Forum Copilot app, or replace it with your own App Store ID if you ship a branded version.
Configure ForumCopilot push notification settings for mobile app integration
